claims.claim: India v Pakistan, T20 World Cup, MCG, 23 Oct 2022: Pakistan 159/8, India 160/6 won by four wickets off the last ball; Kohli 82* (53), 6 fours, 4 sixes
after 18 overs 129/4; 19th over by Rauf: 1, 1, 0, 1, 6, 6 -> 28 needed off 8 before the fifth ball, 16 off 6 after the sixes
Rauf's first three overs 22 runs; 15 off the 19th
last over (Nawaz): no-ball six, wide, free hit Kohli bowled, three byes, stumped, wide, single off the last legal ball; three of Kohli's four sixes in the final eight balls
archive, men's T20 with line and length (1,632 back-of-a-length balls on the stumps, overs 17-20): six 1 in 12, straight six 1 in 51
archive: men's T20 chases needing 25-31 off 8 balls with at most 5 down: 4 wins in 29 (small sample)
Rauf: three slower balls in the over; no idea Kohli could hit him down the ground off that length; does not think he can do it again. Kohli: 'Till this date, I don't know how I pulled off that shot'
